summary_1line: Kauravas raid Virata’s cattle; Prince Uttara boasts of defeating them but needs a charioteer, while Arjuna secretly arranges to serve as the disguised Brihannala.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kaurava warriors in chariots drive away a vast herd of cattle while terrified cowherds cry out across the dust-filled plain.
In the women’s quarters, Prince Uttara proudly boasts of defeating Bhishma, Karna, and Drona while the disguised Arjuna listens quietly nearby.
Princess Uttara walks toward the dancing hall to summon the tall, eunuch-disguised Brihannala, who waits among musical instruments.
